text: [image: Ballots go in the mail across Washington today. Vote the whole ballot, top to bottom, and return it early – by mail with no stamp needed, or at any drop box. Then check in with two people you know and make sure they do the same. Not registered yet? You can still register online or by mail through October 26, or in person through Election Day, November 3. VoteWA.gov]

[image: Good wine, better conversation in Liberty Lake. Thank you to everyone who came out on a Wednesday night to talk about lowering costs and getting Eastern Washington the representation it deserves.]

[image: Nearly 30 sign wavers on the streets, and the honks did not stop. Thank you to every volunteer who shows up with a sign and a smile. Ballots are in mailboxes now: vote top to bottom and return it early.]

[image: Thank you to our Kendall Yard hosts, and to everyone who came with questions, ideas, and a lot of heart. Rooms like this are how we win. Want to host your own gathering? https://f.mtr.cool/nx1y9k7c9e]

[image: The Conroy Convoy rolled into Pullman! Eastern Washington is a big district, and our volunteers cover every mile of it. Whitman County, we see you. Cougs: register or update your address at VoteWA.gov by Oct. 26.]
[image: The Spokesman-Review lined up where Michael Baumgartner and I stand on the issues, side by side. Read it before you fill out your ballot. The choice is clear. https://f.mtr.cool/azr57im1u1]
